acceptanceCriteria: run --attach waits out a pending redo within the CTS-V0-006 budget instead of refusing at once, with a deterministic test that holds the supervisor between link and rename.
100 runs of TestATRV0008_DetachedRunSurvivesItsLauncher under load show no REDO_PENDING failure, with the counts retained.
body: Found in lane L (V1-0949, PR beamfall/corvint#748). `run --attach` (internal/tasks/cli/attempt_detach.go:723 at main 408c83bc) reads the head with a bare snapshot.Probe, which has no CTS-V0-006 patience, so it refuses REDO_PENDING immediately while the detached supervisor is mid-publish (between a receipt link and its head rename). Observed 3-5 failures per 100 runs of TestATRV0008_DetachedRunSurvivesItsLauncher under load (-race, -cpu 1,4, GOMAXPROCS=3, load 20-211). Expected: the attach read waits out a live writer's publish like other unlocked readers. Related to V1-0849 (flake umbrella) but a product read-path gap, not only a test flake.
